description: Get a customer by id. By default `customer_id` is the Numeral id (cus_...); set id_type to "reference" to look up by your own reference_customer_id. Returns name, email, and tax-exempt status. Numeral: GET /tax/customers/{customer_id}.

customer_id.description: The customer id — a Numeral id (cus_...) by default, or your reference id when id_type="reference".

id_type.description: Which id space `customer_id` is in (default: numeral).

name: numeral_get_customer
title: Get customer
